items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 11 at 10:21AM AKST until November 11 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Patchy blowing snow. Total snow accumulations
up to 5 inches near White Pass. Winds gusting as high as 35 mph.

* WHERE...Klondike Highway past milepost 10.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM AKST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Snow may begin as a mix, but will soon
transition over to accumulating snow as temperatures cool.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For the latest road
conditions where available call 511 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 11 at 7:30AM AKST until November 11 at 1:00PM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Freezing Rain. Total ice accumulation of a glaze up to a few
hundredths of an inch.

* WHERE...Interior Kenai Peninsula and Turnagain Pass.

* WHEN...Until 1 PM AKST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult. Exercise caution while
driving.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Expect a wide variety of road surface
conditions with changing elevations. The most likely area to
observe freezing rain is from Granite Creek to the Hope Cutoff.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 11 at 5:34AM AKST until November 11 at 12:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 15 to 20 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...Western Kupreanof Island and Kuiu Island.

* WHEN...Until noon AKST today.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use caution.
